subject: Progression playbook + evaluation heatmap — post-signature MAP for Mosaic Health
messages:
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Cortez <acortez@mosaichealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Progression playbook + evaluation heatmap — post-signature MAP for Mosaic Health

Alexandra / Tom —

Thanks again for signing; excited to get Mosaic across the finish line. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that combines the implementation sprint cadence, our evaluation plan (prompt sets + success criteria), and the proposed canary/migration windows. Key asks in this note: please confirm the two training cohorts (Clinical Ops, Support) and the preferred go-live week windows listed below.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): executive alignment, access provisioning, MAP finalization (you)
- Weeks 1–2 (prep): infra provisioning, dataset snapshot & prompt alignment, pilot training cohort 1
- Weeks 3–4 (canary): internal canary with 10% traffic, run eval set A/B, iterate prompts
- Weeks 5–6 (migration + training): staged cutover by customer segment, cohort 2 training, full acceptance testing

Acceptance criteria (we'll use these to gate each phase):
- Canary latency within SLO: p95 < 450ms for 99% of requests
- Quality: BLEU/Likert thresholds on eval prompt set (attached) and no critical errors reported in top-10 scenarios
- Operational: successful autoscaling test and KV cache hit rate >= 60% for typical sessions

Attachments: MAP_Mosaic_20250609.xlsx (MAP + task owners), eval_prompt_set_v1.csv (initial eval prompts).

Can you confirm: (1) preferred kickoff date (we're proposing June 16), (2) which two folks you'll nominate as training leads, and (3) whether Mosaic wants the canary window to be internal-only or include a small external beta?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0124

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear plan. June 16 kickoff works for the exec alignment session (I'll invite our Head of Clinical Ops). We propose the two training leads be: Dr. Priya Sharma (clinical) and Marco Reyes (support). Both will be looping in their teams.

We'd prefer the canary to be internal-only for the first 2 weeks, then a 1-week external beta with a small patient support cohort (approx 200 sessions). Can you clarify the rollback SLA for the beta if quality regressions are observed?

I'll review the MAP and eval prompts today and provide any redlines by EOD.

Thanks,
Alexandra

acortez@mosaichealth.com

Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Progression playbook + evaluation heatmap — post-signature MAP for Mosaic Health

Thanks Alex / Vanessa — quick notes from infra/ops perspective: 

- Canary design: internal-only fold for 14 days; traffic routed via our staging pool with dedicated KV prefix. We'll provision a small dedicated GPU pool (2 x A10g equivalent) for the first canary week and scale to 4 if we need to expand to external beta.
- Rollback SLA: if quality drops below the agreed thresholds (see MAP acceptance criteria) for >30 minutes aggregated or any single P0 incident, ops will trigger automated rollback to the previous model variant and pause external traffic. We'll log the incident in the shared Drive folder and follow the RCA cadence (24–48 hours).
- Eval plan: recommend running eval_prompt_set_v1.csv as A/B against current production baseline and proposed model variant; include human raters for top-20 edge prompts during canary.

Action items for Redwood: finalize quantization profile (karthik), schedule autoscaling test (jonas), and provide a one-pager rollback runbook to Mosaic before kickoff.

-Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

I'll prepare two quantization profiles (int8 and mixed-precision) and provide perf regressions by Wednesday (2025-06-11). For the canary, recommend starting with mixed-precision to reduce latency risk and then test int8 for cost comparison during the external beta.

I'll add the perf matrices to the Drive link and flag expected token-cost delta so Mosaic can budget for the first month.
